featured.title: Wedding Planning & Coordination
featured.photoAlt: Garden wedding ceremony beneath a white pergola dressed with white florals
featured.detailAlt: Close-up of a white bouquet with a keepsake charm wrapped around the stems
body: Your wedding day should feel as beautiful as it looks. Whether you'd like a planner by your side from the very first idea, or a coordinator to take the reins in the final month, ABailey Events manages the vendors, timelines and logistics with calm, organized care.
We handle the details behind the scenes, so you can relax, be present, and enjoy every moment with the people you love.

bloomBar.title: Bloom Bar Services
bloomBar.photoAlt: Garden Bloom Bar with a white floral arch, flower cart, fringed umbrella and tiered buckets of fresh flowers
bloomBar.detailAlt: Girl getting help wrapping her bouquet
body: Our signature Bloom Bar is an interactive floral experience your guests will love. We style a beautiful fresh-flower bar where guests build their own bouquets to take home — part décor, part activity, and a keepsake from your celebration.
We bring the flowers, the styled bar and a wrapping station, and help each guest put together a bouquet they'll love.

also: Planning a bridal shower, birthday or corporate event? We'd love to help with that too.
